what_this_is: Facts measured from the rendered primary board. There is no aggregate score, no weighting and no ranking. Adjudication is the user's.

method.slot_/hit_: getBoundingClientRect() of the nearest button/link/row ancestor — the actual pointer target, never derived from the viewBox.
method.ink_bbox: Union of every shape's getBBox() in viewBox units, expanded by half the computed stroke-width where the family strokes, converted to CSS px by rendered_width / viewBox_width. Fill-only families (Phosphor Regular) get no expansion because none applies. Deterministic, no added dependency.
method.center_offset: ink_bbox centre minus the svg box centre, CSS px. Positive x = ink sits right of centre.
method.ink_coverage: ink_bbox area / svg box area. A bounding-box occupancy ratio, NOT optical weight and NOT ink area.
method.clipped: true when ink_bbox leaves the svg box.
method.NO MATCH rows: slot and hit are still measured; every ink field is not_measured because nothing is rendered.
